bed_type: Two queen beds and one sofa bed
source_description: Garden Courtyard Family Suite — Spanning 86 square metres, this suite sleeps up to five guests with two queen beds in the bedroom and a sofa bed in the separate living room. The private terrace faces the hotel’s landscaped garden courtyard. The suite includes a dining table, a full-size refrigerator, a microwave, and a washer-dryer.
